CREATE TABLE robot_maintenance_status AS
SELECT 
    mf.upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
    (mf.faultpredscore + (1 / mf.rulhours)) AS maintenance_priority,
    mf.faultpredscore AS fault_score,
    mf.rulhours AS remaining_life,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS timestamp
FROM 
    maintenance_and_fault mf;
